author: Chris Schommer
title: Jacob Gonzalez drives in three in win over Orioles
desc: Jacob Gonzalez went 2-for-4 in an 8-2 win over the Orioles with a double, two runs scored, and three RBI.
impact: Gonzalez continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in three of his last four contests. The infielder continues to battle inconsistent stretches at the plate for manager Will Venable, batting .235 with two home runs, 14 RBI, and 10 runs scored across 23 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Junior Caminero to participate in home run derby
desc: Junior Caminero announced that he is the first participant in this year's home run derby.
impact: Caminero has been one of the hottest hitters in the league as of late, hitting home runs in four straight games with six long balls in that span. He is tied for fifth in the majors with 22 home runs on the season.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Miguel Vargas doubles, swipes base in win over Orioles
desc: Miguel Vargas went 1-for-4 in a win over the Orioles with a double, one walk, and one stolen base.
impact: Vargas has caught fire again at the plate, picking up hits in each of his last seven contests. The infielder continues to reward manager Will Venable with an explosive, yet streaky bat in the White Sox lineup, posting an .866 OPS with 19 home runs, 52 RBI, 56 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 82 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Hayden Wesneski (elbow) starting rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Hayden Wesneski will begin a rehab assignment in the Florida Complex League on Tuesday.
impact: Wesneski underwent Tommy John surgery last May and has slowly been working his way back since. He'll likely look to return at some point in August.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jake Fraley (hernia) starting rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Jake Fraley is starting a rehab assignment at Triple-A Durham on Tuesday.
impact: Fraley underwent sports hernia surgery in the middle of May. He should be activated by the middle of July.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Dane Myers (wrist) has X-rays come back negative
desc: Reds outfielder Dane Myers (wrist) had X-rays come back negative.
impact: Myers was injured when he violently crashed into the center field wall to make a catch on Monday against the Brewers. Reds skipper Terry Francona said while Myers' X-rays didn't reveal a fracture, the team sent him to the hospital for pain management and additional tests. A stint on the injured list seems to be a possibility at this point.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gavin Lux (shoulder) starting rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Gavin Lux is starting a rehab assignment at Triple-A Durham on Tuesday.
impact: Lux had a shoulder impingement back in April and has suffered multiple setbacks since then. He'll likely require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Sean Burke battles command in win over Orioles
desc: Sean Burke allowed two earned runs on four hits and three walks while striking out eight over 5 1/3 innings in Monday's win over the Orioles.
impact: Burke continues a strong stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in six of his last eight contests. The right-hander has fought inconsistent command at times for manager Will Venable, posting a 3.69 ERA and 1.22 WHIP with a 5-4 record and 9.2 K/9 ratio through 17 appearances.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Austin Slater re-signs with Rays on minors pact
desc: The Rays and outfielder Austin Slater have agreed to a minor league deal.
impact: Slater elected free agency just last week after being designated for assignment by the Rays, but will return to the club on a minor league pact. He hit .231 without a homer and four stolen bases in 74 plate appearances for the Rays this season, but it's his work against left-handed pitching that will decide his future with the club.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Brice Turang goes deep in win over Reds
desc: Brice Turang went 1-for-4 in win over the Reds with a solo home run.
impact: Turang has heated back up at the plate, recording hits in six of his last eight contests. The infielder offers manager Pat Murphy one of the more impactful options in the Brewers lineup, carrying an .815 OPS with 12 homers, 48 RBI, 59 runs scored, and 13 steals through 78 games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Louis Varland flirts with danger, earns save Monday versus Mets
desc: Blue Jays closer Louis Varland pitched a scoreless ninth inning to earn the save on Monday against the Mets.
impact: It wasn't a clean inning for Varland as he surrendered a single and a walk with one out in the ninth, but managed to rack up strikeouts of Mark Vientos and Ronny Mauricio to end the threat. Varland is now a perfect 17-for-17 in save opportunities since taking over as Blue Jays closer, posting a 0.98 ERA, 0.96 WHIP, and a 64:13 K:BB across 46 innings on the campaign.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Joey Ortiz homers in win over Reds
desc: Joey Ortiz went 1- for-4 in a win over the Reds with a two-run home run.
impact: Ortiz has offered mixed results at the plate, collecting hits in six of his last 12 contests. The infielder remains one of the more underwhelming bats when in the Brewers lineup for manager Pat Murphy, slashing .201 with two homers, 17 RBI, 20 runs scored, and five steals across 69 games.

author: Brenton Kemp
title: Trey Yesavage excellent in win over Mets Monday
desc: Blue Jays right-hander Trey Yesavage pitched 6 2/3 innings, allowing just one earned run while earning the win over the Mets on Monday.
impact: Yesavage was as solid as it gets in this one, allowing just three hits while walking none and striking out three in his 6 2/3 innings of work. His lone blemish was a Francisco Lindor solo home run in the seventh inning, but Yesavage otherwise kept the Mets in check on Monday. The most encouraging sign was his zero free passes after he allowed five walks in his previous start against the Astros, the third time over a five-start stretch in which he walked at least five. The 22-year-old will look to keep rolling in a road matchup against the Mariners this weekend.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Robert Gasser limits damage Monday against Reds
desc: Robert Gasser allowed three earned runs on seven hits and one walk while striking out five over 5 2/3 innings in Monday's win over the Reds.
impact: Gasser has provided mixed results on the mound of late, allowing three earned runs or more in three of his last six trips to the mound. The left-hander remains one of the more inconsistent options in a strong Brewers rotation for manager Pat Murphy, posting a 4.54 ERA and 1.29 WHIP with a 1-3 record and 9.1 K/9 ratio through seven starts.

author: Nate Miller
title: Yovanny Cruz recalled on Tuesday
desc: Yovanny Cruz was called up by the Yankees ahead of Tuesday's game against the Tigers.
impact: Cruz made a couple of appearances for the Yankees back in May, giving up no runs on one hit with three strikeouts across 2 1/3 innings. The 26-year-old righty will be available out of the bullpen Tuesday night.
